verdicts.reason: Both break the product lockup the same way: the cream circle behind the can ends up orphaned and clipped in the bottom-left corner, so the can melts into the orange background as a faint outline. Both also leave a small headline, a tiny subhead and large dead bands of space. A at least left-aligns the headline and subhead on one edge. B indents the subhead from the headline for no reason and pushes the headline cramped toward the top, so its text block looks more arbitrary.
